# Barbershop.wtf

> Early-2000s American barbershop vibes online: a boombox player streaming throwback hip-hop & R&B. Remember the $15 fade.

Barbershop.wtf is a free, no-login web experience — not a booking app, not a salon directory. It recreates the feeling of a corner shop with a boombox on the counter playing early-2000s hits.

## Key facts

- **What:** Ambient music site / cultural nostalgia experience
- **Who:** Anyone who wants early-2000s hip-hop & R&B in a barbershop atmosphere
- **Price:** Free
- **Hook:** "Remember the $15 fade?"
- **Tagline:** "$15 fades boombox on the counter. No aircompressor."
- **URL:** https://barbershop.wtf/

## How it works

1. Open https://barbershop.wtf/
2. Hit play on the boombox player (YouTube embeds under a custom UI)
3. Optional: open the Spotify or YouTube Music playlist links

## Optional outbound playlists

- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7h9ndhinByPjiFLlfnRZ2Q?si=qhk4ciSpTPyv--oAX514fw
- YouTube Music playlist: linked from the site header
